BearerAuth.description: Standard Bearer JWT token obtained from `/api/auth/login` or `/api/auth/register`.

info.description:
Production-grade OpenAPI 3.0 specification for the Distributed Ticket Booking System.
Covers Authentication, Event Catalog, Seat Inventory, Booking & Saga Orchestration,
Waitlist Management, and RabbitMQ Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) operations.
info.title: Distributed Ticket Booking System API

post.description: Verifies user credentials and generates a signed JWT token.

get.description: Returns profile details for the authenticated user context.

post.description: Creates a new user account with hashed password credentials and returns a JWT bearer token.

get.description: Retrieves a list of all registered accounts. Restricted to administrators.
Decodes and validates the caller's JWT token, returning token claims.

401.description: Token is expired, malformed, or missing

get.description: Retrieves booking records with optional filters for user, event, or status.

post.description:
Initiates a multi-step Saga distributed transaction: reserves inventory, captures payment,
and generates confirmed tickets. Supports replay-safe idempotency.

parameters.description: Unique client key for preventing double charging and duplicate reservations
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

200.description: Idempotent replay of previously confirmed booking

X-Idempotent-Replay.description: Indicates request was served from cached idempotency record

delete.description: Cancels confirmed booking and triggers compensating inventory release.

get.description: Retrieves single booking record with individual ticket barcode tokens.

parameters.description: Booking ID or booking reference code
parameters.name: id

post.description: Alternative POST endpoint to cancel a booking and execute compensating releases.

delete.description: Administrative purge of all unprocessable poison messages.

get.description: Inspects failed messages currently dwelling in the dead letter exchange.

post.description: Re-queues dead-lettered messages back into primary processing queues for reprocessing.
Diagnostics endpoint to trigger controlled failures and test dead-letter routing.

get.description: Inspects active message count, consumer readiness, and unroutable dead-letter depth.
get.summary: Get RabbitMQ Dead Letter Queue telemetry

get.description: Retrieves upcoming events with active ticket tiers. Results are cached in Redis with a 30s TTL.

parameters.description: Optional filter by event category (e.g., Music, Sports, Theatre)
parameters.name: category

parameters.description: Optional search string matching event titles or descriptions
parameters.name: search

get.description: Retrieves detailed metadata for a single event including all ticket tier pricing and capacities.

post.description: Compensating transaction endpoint called during Saga rollback or customer booking cancellation.
Finalizes a temporary reservation into permanently BOOKED seats upon payment confirmation.
Maintenance endpoint that audits expired HOLD seats and returns them to AVAILABLE.
post.summary: Trigger janitor sweep of expired holds

post.description: Manually or automatically releases held seats back to AVAILABLE status.

get.description: Queries the status, remaining hold duration, and seat assignments for a reservation.

post.description: Places a temporary hold (default 120s) on specified seats using distributed Redis locking.

parameters.description: Unique idempotency key to prevent duplicate reservation calls
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

409.description: Conflict - Seats are already held or booked

get.description: Returns aggregate seat availability, booked count, and hold count grouped by tier.
Returns a matrix of all seats, rows, seat numbers, and current hold/booked statuses.
Lists waitlist queue status filtered by event, user, or status.

post.description: Enqueues a customer onto the FIFO waitlist when an event or ticket tier is sold out.

get.description: Returns position in queue, promotion timestamp, and hold expiry.

post.description: Alternate endpoint to cancel a waitlist reservation.
Converts a promoted waitlist hold into a confirmed booking.

get.description: Returns operational readiness and status of components (PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ) and uptime.

503.description: System dependency is unhealthy or degraded

get.description: Returns Go runtime memory metrics, database connection pool saturation, Redis pool statistics, and Prometheus exposition.

parameters.description: Exposition format (JSON default, or Prometheus text format)
parameters.name: format
